content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

The architecture behind Bitcoin payments for digital downloads is crucial for creators looking to maintain control over their sales. Unlike traditional payment processors that charge high fees, such as Gumroad's 10% per transaction, NOWPayments charges only 0.5%. This difference means substantial savings for creators, especially at scale. For example, if a creator sells 100 units of a $97 product in a month, the fee difference could retain an additional $921. This isn't just about lower fees; it's about creating a sustainable income model that empowers creators.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The underlying architecture consists of several components that work together to facilitate Bitcoin payments seamlessly. Digital products are hosted on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, providing a reliable and cost-effective solution for delivery. Upon purchase, the NOWPayments gateway processes the transaction, verifying payment on-chain at a minimal fee. The delivery of digital products is automated through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring that the customer receives their purchase instantaneously. This architecture eliminates the reliance on traditional payment platforms, granting creators autonomy over their sales.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed for digital creators who have been locked out of mainstream payment solutions. Whether you're selling ebooks, templates, or online courses, this system caters specifically to those in regions facing financial isolation. It's for creators who prioritize ownership and control over their sales process. By leveraging this architecture, you can build a sovereign digital commerce stack that operates independently of traditional platforms. The system is built for resilience, offering creators a way to thrive in challenging economic environments.
NOWPayments offers the lowest fees in the market at just 0.5%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of this architecture include hosting solutions like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend processing via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and payment processing through NOWPayments. Each piece plays a vital role in ensuring smooth operation. For instance, GitHub Pages provides stable hosting for your digital products, while NOWPayments allows for the acceptance of over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal transaction fees. This combination creates an effective ecosystem that supports diverse product offerings and ensures creators retain full ownership and control.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own sovereign digital commerce stack, begin by selecting your hosting solution, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle transaction requests and automate delivery. Integrate NOWPayments to accept Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies, ensuring instant payment verification. Load your products and test the entire process. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for resources and consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for an all-in-one solution to streamline your deployment.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
You maintain complete ownership of your digital products and customer data.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip, consider building your own commerce stack using the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit provides all the necessary blueprints and templates for a successful deployment, enabling you to operate independently from traditional platforms.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I accept Bitcoin payments for my digital downloads?

You can accept Bitcoin payments by integrating NOWPayments into your digital storefront. This allows you to process transactions easily and securely, ensuring that customers can purchase your products using Bitcoin.
What are the benefits of using NOWPayments compared to traditional platforms?
NOWPayments charges only a 0.5% fee, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad, which takes 10%. This means more revenue remains with you, allowing for greater profitability and sustainability.
Can I sell more than just ebooks with this setup?
Absolutely. This architecture supports a variety of digital products, including courses, templates, fonts, and software. You have the flexibility to sell anything that can be delivered digitally.
What if I need help with deployment?

Consider purchasing the Complete Builder Kit, which includes comprehensive documentation and templates, making the deployment process easier. You'll have access to everything you need to build and scale your online store.
Is my data secure with this setup?
Yes, by using this architecture, you own your data completely. There are no third-party platforms involved that can access or control your information, ensuring privacy and security.
Say goodbye to platform dependency and hello to infrastructure sovereignty.
